about_the_game:
Eat, survive, surpass. In Microbian, you’ll have to rely on your instincts in order to experience the cycle of life.

In this game, you will evolve and discover new paths, playing as a Microbian that changes its form and actions, while consuming all the resources in its way. But…you might not be the only one.

Play in this artisanal and watercolored world, while you explore different biomes, discover new and strange creatures, and fight to survive in this cruel place.

Are you ready to evolve?
